# Automation coverage

Which rows of [`smoke-test.md`](smoke-test.md) are already proven without a person, and by what. One line per row half: a set of desktops that share one owner. A row's halves cover its tag's desktops exactly once each.

<!-- summary:begin -->
<!-- Generated by `python tests/qa/check-smoke.py lint --write`. Do not edit by hand. -->

| Measure | Count |
|---|---|
| Rows | 408 |
| Row halves | 623 |
| Verdicts per release (row x desktop) | 1886 |
| `streamflex-ctest` halves | 2 (10 verdicts) |
| `streamflex-headless` halves | 230 (920 verdicts) |
| `qa-harness` halves | 0 (0 verdicts) |
| `manual` halves | 391 (956 verdicts) |
| **Automated today** | 232 of 623 halves; 930 of 1886 verdicts (49 %) |

<!-- summary:end -->

## Owners

| Owner | Means | The last column names |
|---|---|---|
| `streamflex-ctest` | a unit test in `tests/` proves it | the test file and function: `` `test_layout.c` `test_resolve` `` |
| `streamflex-headless` | the headless harness (`tests/headless/`) proves it, in Debian and Fedora containers under a virtual display | the check file and run name: `` `58-settings-pickers.sh` run `f58-hex` `` |
| `qa-harness` | qa-harness's five-desktop lane proves it | the lane and arc, never a qa-harness path (that repo is private) |
| `manual` | checked by hand | why it is not automated, or `qa-harness item 75, planned` while that lane has no arc for it |

**The honesty rule.** A half is credited to a check only when the check asserts the row's claim itself, not a neighbor of it. The headless harness proves the app's behavior, not a desktop's: a desktop-specific claim (app-menu launch, Wayland focus, KDE compositing) is never `streamflex-headless`. A half is `qa-harness` only once an arc runs it.
